title: Patch: every Meditative+ and Training Grounds Alt art somewhere else: the same subject in a new place, time or moment, one brief per card
notes: Meditative+'s and Training Grounds' Alt art pass (#3330, on #3393's scenes, after #3396's Classic+ pass). Every Meditative+ and Training Grounds card offered Alt art, 36 of them, now draws an alt scene recipe of its own from a brief per card (R3397000): its subject restaged in another place, time or moment, under a sky sharing no colour with its normal picture's and a new camera (a close-up, a wide or distant view, or one from above), where Alt art had redrawn the normal scene from another seed. A figure keeps the normal picture's person, and a person the brief keeps beside it stays the normal one's; Meditative+ keeps its one red seal, Training Grounds none. Every Alt art level draws the one alt picture, base and Radiant; each clears its rarity's detail floor and the byte ceiling, and in a real browser changes at least 60% of the normal window's sampled points (ALT_PICTURE_CHANGE_MIN). Repaints keep the normal recipe. The scene kit gains a goat, a deer, a duck, walnuts, a crater, a sandcastle, a snowman, a water wheel, a rowboat, a cork board, a washing line, a picnic blanket and a hanging rope. How cards look only: nothing plays differently.

player.title: Every Meditative+ and Training Grounds Alt art restaged
changes: Every Meditative+ and Training Grounds card's Alt art now shows its subject somewhere else, a new place, time or moment, clearly apart from its normal art.
